message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Li gave 400 yuan to his son Li Jr. (already convicted) to escape after police attempted to capture him, and then he harbored him at home, provided food, shelter, and later gave false name to avoid police, provided medical expenses, etc. This is classic "窝藏罪" (concealing a criminal). Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 38? Actually article 38 of Criminal Law: "窝藏、包庇犯罪分子" (concealing or harboring a criminal). So the charge is "窝藏罪". Possibly also "帮助犯罪分子逃跑" (helping a criminal evade law enforcement) which is also covered under the same article. The prosecution says "应当以窝藏罪追究其刑事责任". So answer: [罪名]窝藏罪<eoa>.

The instruction: "一行作答" and format: - 单个罪名: [罪名]盗窃<eoa>. So we output: [罪名]窝藏罪<eoa>.
